cards.example_en: There is a clear hierarchy among the restaurant staff.
cards.example_zh: 这家餐厅的员工之间有明确的等级关系。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指等级结构，也可指组织的最高领导层。

cards.example_en: Falling off his bicycle, my brother hurt his left hip badly.
cards.example_zh: 弟弟从自行车上摔下来，把左边的臀部摔伤了。

cards.example_en: Historically, peasant families often depended on a single harvest, making them particularly vulnerable to drought.
cards.example_zh: 历史上，小农家庭往往依赖一次收成，因此特别容易受到干旱的影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
cards.example_zh: 我在晚饭前做完了作业，然后出门了。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；一项作业用a piece of homework。

cards.example_en: We watched a small boat disappear beyond the horizon.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着一条小船消失在地平线之外。
cards.explain_zh: 表示眼界通常用复数：broaden your horizons。

cards.example_en: We watched a small boat disappear beyond the horizon.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着一条小船消失在地平线之外。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Keep the shelf horizontal while I tighten the screws.
cards.example_zh: 我拧紧螺丝时，请让架板保持水平。
cards.explain_zh: horizontal是水平的，vertical是垂直的。

cards.example_en: The lecture explains how a hormone carries signals through the body.
cards.example_zh: 讲座解释了一种激素如何在体内传递信号。

cards.example_en: Our science teacher showed us how hydrogen burns.
cards.example_zh: 科学老师向我们演示了氢气如何燃烧。
cards.explain_zh: hydrogen是不可数名词，表示化学元素氢或氢气。

cards.example_en: We bought identical jackets without knowing about each other's choice.
cards.example_zh: 我们在不知道对方选择的情况下，买了完全一样的夹克。
cards.explain_zh: 常用 identical to；比 similar 的相似程度更强。

cards.example_en: The receptionist asked me to show some identification.
cards.example_zh: 接待员请我出示身份证明。
cards.explain_zh: 表示身份证明时通常不可数，可简称 ID。

cards.example_en: Early identification of learning difficulties allows schools to provide appropriate support before students fall behind.
cards.example_zh: 及早识别学习困难，能让学校在学生掉队之前提供适当的支持。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Their political ideology shapes how they discuss everyday problems.
cards.example_zh: 他们的政治理念影响着他们讨论日常问题的方式。
cards.explain_zh: 指成体系的社会或政治观念，不是单个想法。

cards.example_en: Their political ideology shapes how they discuss everyday problems.
cards.example_zh: 他们的政治理念影响着他们讨论日常问题的方式。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This optical illusion makes the flat drawing look three-dimensional.
cards.example_zh: 这种视错觉让平面的图画看起来像立体的。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The vet explained that vaccination would make our puppy immune.
cards.example_zh: 兽医解释说，接种疫苗会让我们的小狗获得免疫力。
cards.explain_zh: immune to指不受影响；immune from常指获豁免。

cards.example_en: Her welcoming smile was an implicit invitation to join.
cards.example_zh: 她热情的笑容是在默默邀请我们加入。
cards.explain_zh: implicit指未明说；explicit指清楚明确。

cards.example_en: The project saves water and, more importantly, reduces waste.
cards.example_zh: 这个项目节约用水，更重要的是减少浪费。

cards.example_en: I bought this bright yellow umbrella on impulse.
cards.example_zh: 我一时冲动买了这把亮黄色的伞。
cards.explain_zh: on impulse表示一时冲动；后接动作常用impulse to do。

cards.example_en: I bought this bright yellow umbrella on impulse.
cards.example_zh: 我一时冲动买了这把亮黄色的伞。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The study compares the incidence of the condition in two age groups.
cards.example_zh: 这项研究比较了两个年龄组中这种状况的发生率。

cards.example_en: I incline towards the cheaper option for our holiday.
cards.example_zh: 对于我们的假期，我倾向于选择更便宜的方案。
cards.explain_zh: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈɪnklaɪn/。

cards.example_en: Menus improve with the inclusion of fresh fruit at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午餐菜单因为纳入新鲜水果而变得更好。

cards.example_en: It seems incredible that this tiny seed becomes a tree.
cards.example_zh: 这粒小小的种子竟能长成大树，真令人难以置信。
cards.explain_zh: incredible可表难以置信，也可口语赞叹“极好”。

cards.example_en: The soup was incredibly hot, so I waited.
cards.example_zh: 汤特别烫，所以我等了一会儿。
cards.explain_zh: 常修饰形容词或副词；句首可表示“难以置信的是”。

cards.example_en: The incumbent mayor promised to improve public transport.
cards.example_zh: 现任市长承诺改善公共交通。

cards.example_en: My grandmother still lives independently in her own flat.
cards.example_zh: 我祖母仍独立生活在自己的公寓里。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“不依赖于……”用independently of。

cards.example_en: Students who learn to work independently are often better prepared for the demands of higher education.
cards.example_zh: 学会独立完成任务的学生，往往能更好地应对高等教育的要求。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Attendance is a useful indicator of how the class is coping.
cards.example_zh: 出勤率是一个有用的指标，可以看出班级适应得如何。

cards.example_en: Her indifference surprised me when I shared my exciting news.
cards.example_zh: 我分享令人兴奋的消息时，她的冷淡让我很意外。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；对某事冷漠用 indifference to。

cards.example_en: Public indifference to local elections can weaken accountability and reduce the quality of democratic representation.
cards.example_zh: 公众对地方选举漠不关心，可能削弱问责机制并降低民主代表的质量。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These flowers are indigenous to the valley near our village.
cards.example_zh: 这些花原产于我们村庄附近的山谷。
cards.explain_zh: 常用indigenous to；修饰人群时常将首字母大写。

cards.example_en: Protecting indigenous languages helps preserve cultural knowledge that has been passed down through many generations.
cards.example_zh: 保护原住民语言有助于保存世代相传的文化知识。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This plant grows best in bright but indirect sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 这种植物在明亮但不直射的阳光下长得最好。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指影响经由中间环节，也可指表达不直白。

cards.example_en: This plant grows best in bright but indirect sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 这种植物在明亮但不直射的阳光下长得最好。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The teacher spoke to each student individually.
cards.example_zh: 教师分别与每名学生谈话。

cards.example_en: A change in temperature can induce a change in the material's structure.
cards.example_zh: 温度变化会引起材料结构的变化。

cards.example_en: Our induction included a tour of the whole office.
cards.example_zh: 我们的入职培训包括参观整个办公室。
cards.explain_zh: 入职常用induction；归纳与deduction演绎相对。

cards.example_en: A structured induction programme can help new employees understand workplace expectations and adapt to their roles.
cards.example_zh: 系统的入职培训可以帮助新员工了解工作要求并适应岗位。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The city grew rapidly during a period of industrialization.
cards.example_zh: 这座城市在工业化时期迅速发展。

cards.example_en: As countries industrialize, governments must balance economic growth with environmental protection and workers' welfare.
cards.example_zh: 随着各国实现工业化，政府必须兼顾经济增长、环境保护和工人福利。
cards.explain_zh: 可及物也可不及物；英式也拼作industrialise。

cards.example_en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
cards.example_zh: 投资早期教育可能是逐步减少不平等的最佳方式。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The article explores the causes of social inequality in large cities.
cards.example_zh: 这篇文章探讨大城市社会不平等的成因。

cards.example_en: Without regular watering, these flowers will inevitably die.
cards.example_zh: 如果不定期浇水，这些花必然会枯死。
cards.explain_zh: 语气比probably强，表示结果无法避免。

cards.example_en: One sick rabbit can infect the others in its cage.
cards.example_zh: 一只生病的兔子可能传染同笼的其他兔子。
cards.explain_zh: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

cards.example_en: His infectious laugh soon had everyone at the table smiling.
cards.example_zh: 他富有感染力的笑声很快让桌边的每个人都笑了起来。
cards.explain_zh: infectious表示有传染性；infected表示已被感染。

cards.example_en: Her muddy boots supported my inference about her morning walk.
cards.example_zh: 她沾满泥的靴子印证了我关于她早晨散过步的推断。
cards.explain_zh: 常用draw an inference from，指根据证据推断。

cards.example_en: The cheaper bag felt inferior to the leather one.
cards.example_zh: 那个便宜包摸起来不如皮包好。
cards.explain_zh: 比较用inferior to，不用than；feel inferior指自卑。

cards.example_en: The cheaper bag felt inferior to the leather one.
cards.example_zh: 那个便宜包摸起来不如皮包好。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: The horizontal axis shows time, allowing readers to compare changes in employment across the period.
word.example_zh: 横轴表示时间，方便读者比较该时期内的就业变化。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
